threat_event: Ransomware on the field laptop encrypts files, steals customer data, and spreads toward customer SCADA through the saved remote sessions, the VPN client, or a cable or USB connection to a controller
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One administrator account for email, web, and control work; customer passwords in a plain spreadsheet; no offline backup; no security training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 laptop; SYS-01 files; Customer A and B field systems (BP-02)
existing_controls: Disk encryption; built-in antivirus; automatic updates; Customer A VPN requires its own MFA
treatment_plan: Standard daily account; password manager and delete the spreadsheet; offline program backups; never connect to a customer network with a laptop that shows any alert; security training; P08 runbook

threat_event: Takeover of the business email account leads to fake payment-change emails to customers, theft of customer reports, and the synced password spreadsheet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Email is the reset path for every other account; MFA by text-message codes; password spreadsheet synced into the file account; no sign-in review
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 email and files; BP-03; BP-04
treatment_plan: Authenticator-app MFA and recovery codes in the sealed envelope; delete the spreadsheet and its versions; monthly sign-in review; ask customers to confirm any bank change by phone

threat_event: An attacker uses Customer B's shared, always-on remote-desktop login to reach Customer B's SCADA operator workstation and stop wells or change setpoints
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist (credential stuffing against remote-desktop tools)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared login with unattended access and no MFA; the password was saved in the laptop client until 2026-07-23 and is in the spreadsheet; no agreement on remote access with Customer B
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 Customer B path; Customer B field operations (BP-02)
existing_controls: Saved password removed 2026-07-23; Customer B hardwired tank high-level shutdowns
treatment_plan: Customer B asked 2026-07-24 for named accounts, MFA, and access turned on only for scheduled sessions; until then the owner logs each session and changes the password after any suspected exposure; written remote access terms at MSA renewal

threat_event: Theft of the customer password spreadsheet exposes RTU, modem, operator workstation, and remote-desktop credentials for two customers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plain spreadsheet on the laptop and in the file account; several field devices still use the maker's default passwords
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03; SYS-01; Customer A and B field devices
treatment_plan: Password manager; delete the spreadsheet and file versions; with each customer's approval, change default device passwords; device and credential register

threat_event: Malware reaches a customer controller or operator workstation from a USB drive or the laptop during a site visit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One USB drive used for personal files and programs; drives never scanned; laptop used for web browsing
treatment_plan: Two dedicated, labeled program drives; scan before every site use; personal drive never plugged into customer equipment

threat_event: A wrong or unapproved program or setpoint is loaded to a customer controller and causes a well shutdown, tank battery upset, or release
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change record; approvals by phone (4 of 23 Customer A changes had email approval); no way to tell which program version is in the field
treatment_plan: Email approval before each change; change log with before and after versions; customer gets a copy of the approved program

threat_event: Customer program copies are lost to laptop failure, ransomware, or a sync error, leaving a customer without a known-good program
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Copies only on the laptop and its synced folder; 30-day version history; no offline copy
treatment_plan: Encrypted offline drive updated after every approved change and monthly; customer keeps its own copy

threat_event: Customer A ends or does not renew its MSA because the business does not meet the security schedule (no 24-hour notice process, no cyber coverage, data sent to AI tools, phone approvals)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Security schedule items (2) to (5) and (8) partly or not met; annual questionnaire due 2026-09-30 will show it
existing_controls: Customer A VPN and MFA in use (item 2 met)
treatment_plan: Answer the questionnaire honestly with this POA&M; meet items (3), (4), and (5) by 2026-09-30; buy cyber coverage of at least $1 million (Share/Transfer) by 2026-10-31

threat_event: Customer production data sent to the AI dynamometer service and a free AI chatbot is kept or used for model training without customer consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Uploads started before reading the terms; no customer consent; chatbot used about 12 times
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08; AI-002 chatbot; Customer A and C data
treatment_plan: Customer A consent or the no-training tier; well codes instead of names; chatbot only with no customer data (P10)

threat_event: The owner-operator is suddenly unavailable (illness, injury on site) or loses the only phone, so wells go unchecked and nobody can reach accounts or program copies
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; MFA codes on one phone; coverage arrangement is informal
existing_controls: Informal coverage by a nearby contract pumper
treatment_plan: Written mutual coverage agreement; route sheets in the truck; sealed recovery codes with a family member; customers keep their own program copies (P05)

threat_event: An attacker on the home network (via the router's default admin password or a family device) attacks the laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default router admin password; family devices on the same network
treatment_plan: Change the router password now; new router with a separate network for the laptop

threat_event: The field laptop is stolen from the truck, dropped, or overheated, stopping automation service until a replacement is set up
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One laptop; licensed software tied to the device
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; rugged laptop; IT technician can rebuild in about one working day
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Encryption protects the data and recovery fits the BP-02 MTD of 48 hours; keep the laptop out of sight in the truck

threat_event: Takeover of the accounting service leads to fake invoices, changed bank details, or exposure of helpers' Social Security numbers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on the only account
treatment_plan: Turn on MFA; unique passphrase in the password manager

threat_event: A security incident is not recognized, or the 24-hour Customer A notice or a Florida deadline is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, contact list, or training before 2026-08-31
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and printed contact sheet; walk through it once a year; security training

threat_event: A hurricane stops rounds and service work for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field work only; customers shut in wells before storms
existing_controls: Customers shut in wells; SaaS records reachable from anywhere
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Keep the laptop and paper gauge book in the house; confirm restart order with each customer
